value.heading: A goal measured in everyday routines
value.text: In a 2019 Riverside Medical Clinic interview, Choi describes hearing from patients who can return to things they enjoy—playing with their grandkids, working in the yard, or taking walks—as one of the best parts of his work. He says his goal is to help people get back to regular life as soon as possible. This is his stated motivation and account of patient conversations, not an independently verified outcome or a promise.

proposedChanges.reason: Make the named office's source-stated location, contact, hours, and language information visible together with the unresolved practical access details.

value.heading: Planning a visit
value.text: Riverside Medical Clinic's named profile lists Choi at 7117 Brockton Ave., Riverside, CA 92506, phone (951) 782-3764, with office hours Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m. It lists English under languages spoken but does not say whether other languages or interpreter services are available. The page does not specify fees, insurance plans, referral requirements, or appointment availability; confirm these details with the clinic.

proposedChanges.reason: Map the narrative and patient-facing access facts to their named sources while keeping every new statement source-stated.
